"""Command line entry point."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable, Sequence

from trueup.runner.setups import LIBRARIES

# Exit codes
EXIT_OK = 0  # no mismatches
EXIT_MISMATCH = 1  # mismatches found
EXIT_ERROR = 2  # could not run

KEY_VARS = ("NEATLOGS_API_KEY", "NEATLOGS_PROJECT", "TRUEUP_MODEL_KEY", "TRUEUP_MODEL_BASE_URL")
NOT_BUILT = ("verify", "report")
NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT = "https://ingest.neatlogs.com"


def doctor(http_get: Callable[..., Any] | None = None) -> int:
    ok = sys.version_info >= (3, 12)
    v = sys.version_info
    print(f"python: {v.major}.{v.minor}.{v.micro} ({'ok' if ok else 'need 3.12+'})")
    for name in KEY_VARS:
        # Only report presence. Never print the value.
        state = "set" if os.environ.get(name) else "not set"
        print(f"{name}: {state}")
    print(f"neatlogs: {reach_neatlogs(http_get)}")
    print(f"model proxy: {reach_model(http_get)}")
    return EXIT_OK if ok else EXIT_ERROR


def _get(http_get: Callable[..., Any] | None, url: str, **kw: Any) -> Any:
    import httpx

    kw.setdefault("timeout", 10)
    return (http_get or httpx.get)(url, **kw)


def reach_neatlogs(http_get: Callable[..., Any] | None = None) -> str:
    """One GET to the neatlogs ingest endpoint. Any HTTP reply means reachable."""
    url = os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT") or NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT
    try:
        return f"reachable (HTTP {_get(http_get, url).status_code})"
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        return f"not reachable ({type(e).__name__})"


def reach_model(http_get: Callable[..., Any] | None = None) -> str:
    """One GET to <proxy>/key/info (no model call): reachable, key accepted, spend against the limit."""
    from trueup.model import BASE_VAR, KEY_VAR, SPEND_LIMIT, ModelError, get_spend

    if not os.environ.get(BASE_VAR) or not os.environ.get(KEY_VAR):
        return f"not checked ({BASE_VAR} or {KEY_VAR} not set)"
    try:
        spend = get_spend(os.environ[BASE_VAR], os.environ[KEY_VAR], lambda u, **kw: _get(http_get, u, **kw))
    except ModelError as e:
        return f"reachable, but {e}"
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        return f"not reachable ({type(e).__name__})"
    return f"reachable, key spend ${spend:.4f} of ${SPEND_LIMIT:.2f} limit"


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="trueup",
        description="Find where AI agent traces disagree with what really happened.",
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    for name in NOT_BUILT:
        sub.add_parser(name, help="not built yet")
    sub.add_parser("doctor", help="check the local setup")
    sw = sub.add_parser("sweep", help="run the scenarios against one tracing library")
    sw.add_argument("library", choices=LIBRARIES)
    sw.add_argument("--framework", default="all", choices=("all", "none", "langchain", "openai-agents"),
                    help="none: plain SDK; langchain: LangChain and LangGraph; default all")
    sw.add_argument("--proposed", nargs="?", const="", metavar="FROM",
                    help="sweep accepted planner proposals from scenarios/proposed/<FROM> (default: this library)")
    pl = sub.add_parser("plan", help="ask the model for new scenarios (data only), keep the ones code accepts")
    pl.add_argument("library", choices=LIBRARIES)
    pl.add_argument("--max", type=int, default=5, help="most proposals to ask for (default 5)")
    au = sub.add_parser("audit", help="run your script's main() against the fake provider and compare its trace")
    au.add_argument("script", type=Path, help="Python file with a main() that calls the openai or anthropic SDK")
    au.add_argument("--library", required=True, choices=LIBRARIES, help="tracing library to set up")
    fx = sub.add_parser("fix", help="draft a patch and a test for a finding, verify it, write fixes/<id>/")
    fx.add_argument("finding_id", help="a finding id from findings.json")
    fx.add_argument("--tries", type=int, default=3, help="most patch tries (default 3)")
    fx.add_argument("--locate-only", action="store_true",
                    help="only re-run the locate step and compare it with fixes/<id>/patch.diff (no model call)")
    up = sub.add_parser("upstream", help="draft issue and PR text for a finding into upstream/<id>/ (never posts)")
    up.add_argument("finding_id", help="a finding id from findings.json")
    ck = sub.add_parser("check", help="run the checker and dedupe over a sweep's leads")
    ck.add_argument("run_id", help="a run id under .trueup/runs, or latest")
    ck.add_argument("--library", choices=LIBRARIES, help="with latest: the newest sweep of this library")
    return parser


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    if args.command == "doctor":
        return doctor()
    if args.command == "sweep":
        from trueup.sweep import exit_code, sweep

        proposed = None if args.proposed is None else (args.proposed or args.library)
        if proposed is not None and proposed not in LIBRARIES:
            print(f"trueup sweep: --proposed must name a library: {', '.join(LIBRARIES)}", file=sys.stderr)
            return EXIT_ERROR
        _, results = sweep(Path.cwd(), args.library, args.framework, proposed=proposed)
        return exit_code(results)
    if args.command == "plan":
        return plan_command(args.library, args.max)
    if args.command == "audit":
        from trueup.audit import audit
        from trueup.sweep import exit_code

        _, results = audit(Path.cwd(), args.library, args.script)
        return exit_code(results)
    if args.command == "check":
        from trueup.check import check

        try:
            res = check(Path.cwd(), args.run_id, args.library)
        except (FileNotFoundError, ValueError) as e:
            print(f"trueup check: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            return EXIT_ERROR
        return EXIT_MISMATCH if res["counts"]["findings"] else EXIT_OK
    if args.command == "fix":
        if args.locate_only:
            from trueup.fix import locate_only

            try:
                locate_only(Path.cwd(), args.finding_id)
            except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, RuntimeError) as e:
                print(f"trueup fix: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
                return EXIT_ERROR
            return EXIT_OK
        return fix_command(args.finding_id, args.tries)
    if args.command == "upstream":
        from trueup.upstream import upstream

        try:
            upstream(Path.cwd(), args.finding_id)
        except (FileNotFoundError, KeyError, ValueError) as e:
            print(f"trueup upstream: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            return EXIT_ERROR
        return EXIT_OK
    print(f"trueup {args.command}: not built yet", file=sys.stderr)
    return EXIT_ERROR


def plan_command(library: str, max_n: int) -> int:
    from trueup import tracing
    from trueup.model import ModelError
    from trueup.planner import plan
    from trueup.sweep import new_run_id

    run_id = new_run_id(f"plan-{library}")

    def body() -> int:
        try:
            res = plan(Path.cwd(), library, max_n, run_id=run_id)
        except (ModelError, FileNotFoundError) as e:
            print(f"trueup plan: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            return EXIT_ERROR
        return EXIT_ERROR if res["error"] else EXIT_OK

    return tracing.run_traced(run_id, library, "plan", body)


def fix_command(finding_id: str, tries: int) -> int:
    from trueup import tracing
    from trueup.fix import find_finding, fix
    from trueup.sweep import new_run_id

    try:
        finding, _ = find_finding(Path.cwd(), finding_id)
    except FileNotFoundError as e:
        print(f"trueup fix: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return EXIT_ERROR
    run_id = new_run_id(f"fix-{finding['library']}")

    def body() -> int:
        try:
            res = fix(Path.cwd(), finding_id, run_id=run_id, max_tries=tries)
        except (KeyError, FileNotFoundError) as e:
            print(f"trueup fix: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
            return EXIT_ERROR
        if res["error"]:
            return EXIT_ERROR
        return EXIT_OK if res["fixed"] else EXIT_MISMATCH

    return tracing.run_traced(run_id, finding["library"], "fix", body)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
"""trueup plan <library> [--max N]: the model proposes new scenarios as data; code decides.

The planner reads the library's wrapper source from its venv, the scenario
library and the latest findings, and asks the model for new scenarios as JSON.
Every proposal is checked by trueup.scenarios.proposed (schema, app and fake
behaviour exist, truth matches an untraced run). A rejected proposal goes back
to the model with the reason, at most REVISIONS times. Accepted ones are saved
to scenarios/proposed/<library>/ for `trueup sweep <library> --proposed`.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from trueup import tracing
from trueup.model import PLAN_MODEL, ModelClient, ModelError, record_spend
from trueup.scenarios import ALL
from trueup.scenarios import proposed as prop

REVISIONS = 2
SOURCE_LIMIT = 60_000  # characters of wrapper source sent to the model
FILE_LIMIT = 32_000

# Wrapper files per library, relative to site-packages, most relevant first.
WRAPPER_FILES = {
    "neatlogs": ["neatlogs/openai.py", "neatlogs/anthropic.py"],
    "openllmetry": ["opentelemetry/instrumentation/openai/shared/chat_wrappers.py",
                    "opentelemetry/instrumentation/anthropic/streaming.py",
                    "opentelemetry/instrumentation/openai/v1/responses_wrappers.py"],
    "openinference": ["openinference/instrumentation/openai/_stream.py",
                      "openinference/instrumentation/openai/_request.py",
                      "openinference/instrumentation/anthropic/_stream.py"],
}

SYSTEM = """You plan test scenarios for Trueup, which checks whether an AI tracing library's spans match \
what really happened. A scenario runs one existing app function against a fake provider; the fake model name \
picks the fake's behaviour. You cannot write code: a scenario is JSON data that combines an existing app with an \
existing fake model, plus the truth you expect the run to produce.

Propose scenarios that are NEW (an app + fake model pair not already in the library) and likely to expose a \
tracing bug, given the wrapper source: code paths the existing scenarios miss (a different app reading style on \
the same failure, streaming vs non-streaming, async, tools with errors, refusal through streaming, ...).

Expected truth fields (only listed ones are checked, against what the fake really did):
  calls: number of requests the fake received
  outcome: "ok" or "exception" (what the app saw); exception: the exception class name when outcome is exception
  fake: per call, what the fake did: complete, failed, incomplete, error_event, cut, http_error
  tokens: per call {"input": n, "output": n}, or null when the fake sent no usage
  finish: per call, list of finish reasons / response status
  tool_calls: per call, list of tool names the model asked for
  tool_runs: framework apps only, [{"name", "outcome": "ok"|"raised"}]
  include_usage: per call, whether the app's request asked for stream usage
Facts about the fake: OpenAI replies use 11 input / 7 output tokens, Anthropic 5 / 3. Streams send usage only \
when the app asks (include_usage) on chat; Responses and Anthropic streams always send it. Leave out a field \
when unsure rather than guess; calls, outcome and fake are required, and exception is required when outcome is \
"exception". Each app's "e.g." is what an existing scenario with it does: keep "does" true to the app (an app \
that does not stream does not stream, whatever the fake model).

Reply with JSON only, no prose: {"proposals": [{"id": "p-...", "provider", "api", "framework", "does", "app", \
"model", "expected": {...}, "rationale": "why a wrapper might get this wrong"}]}"""


def wrapper_source(root: Path, library: str) -> str:
    site = next((root / ".trueup" / "venvs" / library / "lib").glob("python*/site-packages"), None)
    if site is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"no venv for {library}; run `trueup sweep {library}` first")
    parts, total = [], 0
    for rel in WRAPPER_FILES[library]:
        f = site / rel
        if not f.exists() or total >= SOURCE_LIMIT:
            continue
        text = f.read_text()[: min(FILE_LIMIT, SOURCE_LIMIT - total)]
        total += len(text)
        parts.append(f"### {rel}\n{text}")
    return "\n\n".join(parts)


def latest_findings(root: Path, library: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    runs = sorted((root / ".trueup" / "runs").glob(f"*-{library}/findings.json"))
    if not runs:
        return []
    d = json.loads(runs[-1].read_text())
    out = [{"title": f["title"], "severity": f["severity"], "check": f["details"]["check"],
            "scenarios": f["details"]["scenarios"]} for f in d["findings"]]
    out += [{"title": f.get("title"), "verdict": "disputed"} for f in d.get("disputed_semantics", [])]
    return out


def library_summary() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [{"id": s.id, "app": s.app, "model": s.model, "framework": s.framework} for s in ALL] + [
        {"id": s.id, "app": s.app, "model": s.model, "framework": s.framework, "proposed": True}
        for s in prop.load()]


def first_prompt(library: str, source: str, findings: list[dict[str, Any]], n: int) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    user = (f"Library under test: {library}.\n\nWhat a scenario may use:\n{json.dumps(prop.catalogue())}\n\n"
            f"Existing scenarios (do not repeat an app + model pair):\n{json.dumps(library_summary())}\n\n"
            f"Current findings for {library}:\n{json.dumps(findings)}\n\n"
            f"Wrapper source of {library} as installed:\n{source}\n\nPropose at most {n} new scenarios.")
    return [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]


def revision_prompt(p: Any, reasons: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    user = (f"What a scenario may use:\n{json.dumps(prop.catalogue())}\n\nExisting app + model pairs:\n"
            f"{json.dumps(sorted({f'{s.app}+{s.model}' for s in ALL}))}\n\nYour proposal:\n{json.dumps(p)}\n\n"
            "It was rejected:\n- " + "\n- ".join(reasons) +
            '\n\nFix it and reply with JSON only: {"proposals": [<the one fixed proposal>]}.'
            ' Reply {"proposals": []} to withdraw it.')
    return [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]


def check(p: Any, taken: set[tuple[str, str]], ids: set[str],
          untraced: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], tuple[list[str], Any]]) -> list[str]:
    reasons = prop.validate(p, taken, ids)
    if reasons:
        return reasons
    diffs, truth = untraced(p)
    if not diffs and truth and p["api"] == "chat" and "include_usage" not in p["expected"]:
        # The untraced run has no library, so its request shows what the app itself asks for.
        # Without this the comparer guesses from tokens and can report a library change that is not one.
        p["expected"]["include_usage"] = truth["include_usage"]
    return diffs


def plan(root: Path, library: str, max_n: int = 5, *, client: ModelClient | None = None,
         run_id: str | None = None, out: Callable[[str], None] = print,
         untraced: Callable[[dict[str, Any]], tuple[list[str], Any]] = prop.untraced_check,
         save: bool = True) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from trueup.sweep import new_run_id

    run_id = run_id or new_run_id(f"plan-{library}")
    run_dir = root / ".trueup" / "runs" / run_id
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    client = client or ModelClient()
    record_spend(run_dir, "before", client)
    result: dict[str, Any] = {"run_id": run_id, "library": library, "model": PLAN_MODEL, "max": max_n,
                              "session_id": tracing.session_id(), "proposals": [], "accepted": [], "rejected": [],
                              "error": None}
    try:
        with tracing.worker("trueup-planner") as span:
            _plan(root, library, max_n, client, result, out, untraced, save)
            tracing.set_verdict(span, f"accepted {len(result['accepted'])}, rejected {len(result['rejected'])}")
    except ModelError as e:
        result["error"] = str(e)
        out(f"planner stopped: {e}")
    finally:
        record_spend(run_dir, "after", client)
        spend = json.loads((run_dir / "spend.json").read_text())
        result["usage"], result["cost_usd"] = spend.get("usage"), spend.get("run_cost_usd")
        (run_dir / "plan.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=1, default=str))
    out(f"proposals: {len(result['proposals'])}  accepted: {len(result['accepted'])}  "
        f"rejected: {len(result['rejected'])}")
    for r in result["rejected"]:
        out(f"  rejected {r['id']}: {'; '.join(r['reasons'])}")
    out(f"tokens: {client.usage.input_tokens} in, {client.usage.output_tokens} out; "
        f"cost ${result['cost_usd'] if result['cost_usd'] is not None else '?'}; wrote {run_dir}")
    return result


def _plan(root: Path, library: str, max_n: int, client: ModelClient, result: dict[str, Any],
          out: Callable[[str], None], untraced: Callable[..., Any], save: bool) -> None:
    source = wrapper_source(root, library)
    findings = latest_findings(root, library)
    out(f"planning for {library}: {len(source)} chars of wrapper source, {len(findings)} findings")
    reply = client.chat_json(PLAN_MODEL, first_prompt(library, source, findings, max_n))
    props = reply.get("proposals") if isinstance(reply, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(props, list):
        raise ModelError('model reply has no "proposals" list; stopping the planner')
    existing = prop.load()
    taken = {(s.app, s.model) for s in existing}
    ids = {s.id for s in existing}
    for p in props[:max_n]:
        result["proposals"].append(p)
        pid = p.get("id", "?") if isinstance(p, dict) else "?"
        history = []
        for attempt in range(REVISIONS + 1):
            reasons = check(p, taken, ids, untraced)
            if not reasons:
                break
            history.append({"proposal": p, "reasons": reasons})
            out(f"  {pid}: rejected ({'; '.join(reasons)[:200]})")
            if attempt == REVISIONS:
                break
            rev = client.chat_json(PLAN_MODEL, revision_prompt(p, reasons))
            revised = rev.get("proposals") if isinstance(rev, dict) else None
            if not revised:
                history.append({"proposal": None, "reasons": ["withdrawn by the model"]})
                reasons = ["withdrawn by the model after: " + "; ".join(reasons)]
                break
            p = revised[0]
        if reasons:
            result["rejected"].append({"id": pid, "reasons": reasons, "tries": len(history), "history": history})
            continue
        taken.add((p["app"], p["model"]))
        ids.add(p["id"])
        path = prop.save(p, library) if save else None
        result["accepted"].append({"id": p["id"], "revisions": len(history), "proposal": p,
                                   "path": str(path) if path else None})
        out(f"  {p['id']}: accepted{f' after {len(history)} revision(s)' if history else ''}")
"""The one model client: the openai SDK against an OpenAI-compatible LiteLLM proxy.

Every call first asks the proxy what the key has spent (GET <base>/key/info) and
refuses to call at or above SPEND_LIMIT. The key and base URL come from
TRUEUP_MODEL_KEY and TRUEUP_MODEL_BASE_URL and are never printed or written.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import re
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

import httpx

PLAN_MODEL = "claude-sonnet-4.6"  # planning and fixing
CHEAP_MODEL = "claude-haiku"  # cheap jobs
SPEND_LIMIT = 15.0  # USD, from the key's spend on the proxy
KEY_VAR, BASE_VAR = "TRUEUP_MODEL_KEY", "TRUEUP_MODEL_BASE_URL"


class ModelError(RuntimeError):
    """The model could not give a usable answer. Stops the worker that asked."""


class SpendLimitReached(ModelError):
    """The key has spent SPEND_LIMIT or more. No call is made."""


def check_model(name: str) -> str:
    if "opus" in name.lower():
        raise ModelError(f"model {name!r} is not allowed (no opus models)")
    return name


def proxy_root(base_url: str) -> str:
    """The proxy's root: the base URL without a trailing /v1."""
    b = base_url.rstrip("/")
    return b[: -len("/v1")] if b.endswith("/v1") else b


def get_spend(base_url: str, key: str, http_get: Callable[..., Any] = httpx.get) -> float:
    """The key's spend in USD, read from info.spend of GET <root>/key/info."""
    r = http_get(proxy_root(base_url) + "/key/info", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"}, timeout=20)
    if r.status_code != 200:
        raise ModelError(f"could not read the key's spend: HTTP {r.status_code}")
    try:
        return float(r.json()["info"]["spend"] or 0.0)
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as e:
        raise ModelError(f"could not read the key's spend: no info.spend in the reply ({type(e).__name__})") from None


def guard(spend: float, limit: float = SPEND_LIMIT) -> None:
    if spend >= limit:
        raise SpendLimitReached(f"spend limit reached: the key has spent ${spend:.4f}, limit ${limit:.2f}. "
                                "No model call made.")


def parse_json(text: str) -> Any:
    """JSON from a model reply; a ```json fence around it is allowed."""
    t = text.strip()
    m = re.fullmatch(r"```(?:json)?\s*(.*?)\s*```", t, re.S)
    return json.loads(m.group(1) if m else t)


@dataclass
class Usage:
    calls: int = 0
    input_tokens: int = 0
    output_tokens: int = 0
    by_model: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = field(default_factory=dict)

    def add(self, model: str, inp: int, out: int) -> None:
        self.calls += 1
        self.input_tokens += inp
        self.output_tokens += out
        m = self.by_model.setdefault(model, {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0})
        m["calls"] += 1
        m["input_tokens"] += inp
        m["output_tokens"] += out

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"calls": self.calls, "input_tokens": self.input_tokens, "output_tokens": self.output_tokens,
                "by_model": self.by_model}


class ModelClient:
    def __init__(self, key: str | None = None, base_url: str | None = None, *, limit: float = SPEND_LIMIT,
                 retries: int = 3, json_retries: int = 2, backoff: float = 2.0,
                 http_get: Callable[..., Any] = httpx.get, openai_client: Any = None,
                 sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep) -> None:
        self.key = key or os.environ.get(KEY_VAR) or ""
        self.base_url = base_url or os.environ.get(BASE_VAR) or ""
        if not self.key or not self.base_url:
            raise ModelError(f"{KEY_VAR} and {BASE_VAR} must be set")
        self.limit, self.retries, self.json_retries, self.backoff = limit, retries, json_retries, backoff
        self.http_get, self.sleep = http_get, sleep
        self.usage = Usage()
        if openai_client is None:
            import openai

            openai_client = openai.OpenAI(api_key=self.key, base_url=self.base_url, max_retries=0, timeout=180)
        self.client = openai_client

    def spend(self) -> float:
        return get_spend(self.base_url, self.key, self.http_get)

    def chat(self, model: str, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], max_tokens: int = 4000) -> str:
        """One completion, after the spend guard, with retries and backoff on API errors."""
        import openai

        check_model(model)
        last: Exception | None = None
        for attempt in range(self.retries + 1):
            guard(self.spend(), self.limit)
            try:
                r = self.client.chat.completions.create(model=model, messages=messages, max_tokens=max_tokens,
                                                        temperature=0.2)
            except (openai.APIConnectionError, openai.APITimeoutError, openai.RateLimitError,
                    openai.InternalServerError) as e:
                last = e
                if attempt < self.retries:
                    self.sleep(self.backoff * 2 ** attempt)
                continue
            except openai.APIStatusError as e:  # 4xx other than 429: retrying will not help
                raise ModelError(f"model call failed: HTTP {e.status_code}") from None
            u = r.usage
            self.usage.add(model, getattr(u, "prompt_tokens", 0) or 0, getattr(u, "completion_tokens", 0) or 0)
            return r.choices[0].message.content or ""
        raise ModelError(f"model call failed after {self.retries + 1} tries: {type(last).__name__}")

    def chat_json(self, model: str, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], max_tokens: int = 4000) -> Any:
        """Like chat, but the reply must be JSON. Invalid JSON is retried, then raises ModelError."""
        msgs = list(messages)
        for attempt in range(self.json_retries + 1):
            text = self.chat(model, msgs, max_tokens)
            try:
                return parse_json(text)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                msgs = [*messages, {"role": "assistant", "content": text},
                        {"role": "user", "content": f"That was not valid JSON ({e.msg}). Reply with JSON only."}]
        raise ModelError(f"model {model} gave invalid JSON {self.json_retries + 1} times; stopping this worker")


def record_spend(run_dir: Path, name: str, client: ModelClient) -> float | None:
    """Write the key's spend to <run_dir>/spend.json under `name` (before/after). None if unreadable."""
    path = run_dir / "spend.json"
    data = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {}
    try:
        spend: float | None = client.spend()
        data[name] = {"spend_usd": spend, "at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())}
    except ModelError as e:
        spend = None
        data[name] = {"error": str(e)}
    if name == "after":
        data["usage"] = client.usage.to_dict()
        if data.get("before", {}).get("spend_usd") is not None and spend is not None:
            data["run_cost_usd"] = round(spend - data["before"]["spend_usd"], 6)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=1))
    return spend
"""Trueup traces itself with neatlogs.

One trueup run = one neatlogs session (session id = run id). Each worker runs as
its own root trace named after it (trueup-planner, trueup-runner, ...), with
trueup.run_id, trueup.library and, where it applies, trueup.verdict.

This is the outer trace only. Scenario runs happen in subprocesses whose env
drops NEATLOGS_API_KEY and sets NEATLOGS_DISABLE_EXPORT / OTEL_*_EXPORTER=none
(trueup.runner.setups), so their spans never leave the machine.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import atexit
import contextlib
import os
import sys
from typing import Any, Callable, Iterator

from trueup import __version__

KEY_VAR = "NEATLOGS_API_KEY"
WORKERS = ("trueup-planner", "trueup-runner", "trueup-comparer", "trueup-checker", "trueup-deduper",
           "trueup-fixer", "trueup-verifier")

_state: dict[str, Any] = {"active": False, "run_id": None, "library": None, "flushed": False}


def active() -> bool:
    return bool(_state["active"])


def session_id() -> str | None:
    return _state["run_id"] if active() else None


def start(run_id: str, library: str, command: str, out: Callable[[str], None] = print,
          init: Callable[..., Any] | None = None) -> bool:
    """neatlogs.init for a command that calls the model. Returns whether tracing is on."""
    _state.update(active=False, run_id=run_id, library=library, flushed=False)
    if not os.environ.get(KEY_VAR):
        out(f"{KEY_VAR} is not set: running without neatlogs tracing")
        return False
    if init is None:
        import neatlogs

        init = neatlogs.init
    try:
        init(api_key=os.environ[KEY_VAR], workflow_name="trueup", instrumentations=["openai"],
             tags=[f"run_id:{run_id}", f"library:{library}", f"trueup:{__version__}", f"command:{command}"])
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - tracing must not stop the run
        out(f"neatlogs init failed ({type(e).__name__}): running without neatlogs tracing")
        return False
    _state["active"] = True
    atexit.register(flush)
    out(f"neatlogs tracing on, session {run_id}")
    return True


def flush() -> None:
    """Flush neatlogs once. Safe to call more than once and when tracing is off."""
    if not active() or _state["flushed"]:
        return
    _state["flushed"] = True
    try:
        import neatlogs

        neatlogs.flush()
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        print(f"neatlogs flush failed ({type(e).__name__})", file=sys.stderr)


@contextlib.contextmanager
def worker(name: str, **attrs: Any) -> Iterator[Any]:
    """A root trace for one worker in the run's session. Yields a span (or None when off)."""
    if name not in WORKERS:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown worker {name!r}")
    if not active():
        yield None
        return
    import neatlogs

    a = {"trueup.run_id": _state["run_id"], "trueup.library": _state["library"], "neatlogs.workflow.name": name,
         **{f"trueup.{k}": v for k, v in attrs.items()}}
    with neatlogs.trace(name=name, kind="AGENT", session_id=_state["run_id"], **a):
        from opentelemetry import trace as otel

        yield otel.get_current_span()


def set_verdict(span: Any, verdict: str) -> None:
    if span is not None:
        span.set_attribute("trueup.verdict", verdict)


def run_traced(run_id: str, library: str, command: str, body: Callable[[], int],

input.command: cat src/trueup/fix.py src/trueup/fixer/patch.py
input.description: Read fix and patch modules

result.output:
"""trueup fix <finding-id>: locate the wrapper, let the model draft a patch and a test, and verify it.

Steps, one library at a time:
  1. locate (trueup.fixer.locate): shallow clone in .trueup/clones/<lib>; Entire's code graph if it
     is there, else ripgrep + ast; locate.json in the run dir and in fixes/<id>/
  2. baseline (verifier): the target packages' own test suites on the clean clone, and the full
     scenario library in .trueup/venvs/<lib>-fix built from the clean clone
  3. up to MAX_TRIES tries: the model drafts edits + a test (trueup.fixer.patch); code applies them;
     the verifier checks that the new test fails before and passes after, the suites show no new
     failure, the finding's scenarios now match truth, and the full library shows no new mismatch.
     A failed try goes back to the model with the reason.
Writes fixes/<id>/: patch.diff, the test file, before-after.md/json, suites.json, locate.json,
tries.json and summary.md. Nothing is committed, pushed or posted. The clone is reset at the end.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from trueup import tracing
from trueup.fixer import locate as loc
from trueup.fixer import patch as pt
from trueup.fixer import targets as tg
from trueup.fixer import verify as vf
from trueup.model import PLAN_MODEL, ModelClient, ModelError, record_spend

MAX_TRIES = 3


def find_finding(root: Path, finding_id: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], Path]:
    """The finding with this id, from the newest findings.json that has it. The id names the library,
    check, field and code path, so the same id in other checked runs (other scenarios, such as
    planner proposals) is the same finding: their scenarios and leads are added to it."""
    found: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], Path]] = []
    for f in sorted((root / ".trueup" / "runs").glob("*/findings.json"), reverse=True):
        found += [(x, f.parent) for x in json.loads(f.read_text())["findings"] if x["id"] == finding_id]
    if not found:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"no finding {finding_id!r} in .trueup/runs/*/findings.json")
    finding, run_dir = json.loads(json.dumps(found[0][0])), found[0][1]
    d = finding["details"]
    d["runs"] = {sid: run_dir.name for sid in d["scenarios"]}
    for other, odir in found[1:]:
        for sid in other["details"]["scenarios"]:
            if sid not in d["scenarios"]:
                d["scenarios"].append(sid)
                d["runs"][sid] = odir.name
        d["leads"] += [m for m in other["details"].get("leads", []) if m["scenario"] not in
                       {x["scenario"] for x in d["leads"]}]
    return finding, run_dir


def all_scenarios() -> list[str]:
    from trueup.scenarios import select
    from trueup.scenarios.proposed import load

    return [s.id for s in select("all")] + [s.id for s in load()]


def _touched(target: tg.Target, files: list[str]) -> list[tg.Package]:
    return [p for p in target.packages if any(f.startswith(p.path.strip("./") + "/" if p.path != "." else "")
                                              for f in files)]


def _short(s: str, n: int = 600) -> str:
    return s if len(s) <= n else s[: n - 3] + "..."


def baseline(root: Path, clone: Path, commit: str, target: tg.Target, fix_dir: Path,
             out: Callable[[str], None]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Suites and sweep on the clean clone. Cached in fix_dir per commit."""
    cache = fix_dir / "baseline.json"
    if cache.exists():
        b = json.loads(cache.read_text())
        if b.get("commit") == commit and all(vf.baseline_usable(s)[0] for s in b["suites"].values()):
            out("baseline: cached for this commit")
            return b
    suites = {}
    for p in target.packages:
        out(f"baseline: {p.path} test venv and test suite (clean clone)")
        tpy = vf.ensure_test_venv(root, clone, target.library, p)
        suites[p.path] = vf.run_pytest(tpy, clone, p, [p.tests])
        s = suites[p.path]
        out(f"  {s.get('passed', '?')} passed, {s.get('failed', '?')} failed, {s.get('errors', '?')} errors, "
            f"exit {s['exit']}")
        ok, why = vf.baseline_usable(s)
        if not ok:
            raise vf.VerifyError(f"{p.path}: {why}")
    out("baseline: building the scenario venv from the clean clone")
    fpy = vf.ensure_fix_venv(root, clone, target.library)
    vf.reinstall(fpy, clone, target)
    out("baseline: full scenario library")
    sweep = vf.sweep_scenarios(fpy, target.library, all_scenarios(), out=out)
    b = {"commit": commit, "suites": suites, "sweep": sweep}
    loc.save(cache, json.dumps(b, indent=1, default=str))
    return b


def verify_try(root: Path, clone: Path, target: tg.Target, finding: dict[str, Any], draft: dict[str, Any],
               writes: list[dict[str, str]], base: dict[str, Any], out: Callable[[str], None]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Apply the try to the clean clone step by step. Returns the try's record with ok and reason."""
    rec: dict[str, Any] = {"ok": False}
    test = draft["test"]
    pkg_of_test = next(p for p in target.packages if test["file"].startswith(
        (p.path.strip("./") + "/" if p.path != "." else "") + p.tests + "/"))
    test_rel = str(Path(test["file"]).relative_to(pkg_of_test.path)) if pkg_of_test.path != "." else test["file"]
    tpy = vf.ensure_test_venv(root, clone, target.library, pkg_of_test)
    loc.reset_clone(clone)
    pt.write_files(clone, [{"file": test["file"], "content": test["content"]}])
    out("  new test on the unpatched code")
    t_before = vf.run_pytest(tpy, clone, pkg_of_test, [test_rel])
    pt.write_files(clone, writes)
    out("  new test on the patched code")
    t_after = vf.run_pytest(tpy, clone, pkg_of_test, [test_rel])
    ok, why = vf.new_test_verdict(t_before, t_after)
    rec["new_test"] = {"before": t_before, "after": t_after, "ok": ok, "reason": why}
    out(f"  {why[:300]}")
    if not ok:
        rec["reason"] = why
        return rec
    rec["suites"] = {}
    for p in _touched(target, [w["file"] for w in writes] + [test["file"]]):
        out(f"  {p.path} test suite (patched)")
        after = vf.run_pytest(vf.ensure_test_venv(root, clone, target.library, p), clone, p, [p.tests])
        ok, why = vf.suite_verdict(base["suites"][p.path], after)
        rec["suites"][p.path] = {"after": after, "ok": ok, "reason": why}
        out(f"  {why[:300]}")
        if not ok:
            rec["reason"] = f"{p.path}: {why}"
            return rec
    fpy = vf.venvs.venv_dir(root, f"{target.library}-fix") / "bin" / "python"  # built by baseline()
    vf.reinstall(fpy, clone, target)
    out("  the finding's scenarios (patched)")
    scen = vf.sweep_scenarios(fpy, target.library, finding["details"]["scenarios"], out=out)
    ok, why = vf.scenario_verdict(scen, finding)
    rec["scenarios"] = {"ok": ok, "reason": why}
    out(f"  {why}")
    if not ok:
        rec["reason"] = why
        return rec
    out("  full scenario library (patched)")
    full = vf.sweep_scenarios(fpy, target.library, all_scenarios(), out=out)
    new = vf.new_mismatches(base["sweep"], full)
    rec["sweep"] = {"totals": vf.totals(full), "new_mismatches": new}
    rec["sweep_after"] = full
    if new:
        rec["reason"] = (f"{len(new)} new mismatch(es) in the full scenario library: " +
                         "; ".join(f"{m['scenario']} {m['check']} {m['field']}: truth {m['truth']}, trace "
                                   f"{m['trace']}" for m in new[:8]))
        out(f"  {rec['reason'][:300]}")
        return rec
    ok, why = vf.scenario_verdict(full, finding)
    rec.update(ok=ok, reason=why if ok else f"full sweep: {why}")
    return rec


def fix(root: Path, finding_id: str, *, client: ModelClient | None = None, run_id: str | None = None,
        out: Callable[[str], None] = print, max_tries: int = MAX_TRIES) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from trueup.sweep import new_run_id

    finding, found_in = find_finding(root, finding_id)
    target = tg.get(finding["library"], finding["details"]["code_path"])
    run_id = run_id or new_run_id(f"fix-{finding['library']}")
    run_dir = root / ".trueup" / "runs" / run_id
    fix_dir = root / "fixes" / finding_id
    run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fix_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for stale in [fix_dir / "patch.diff", *fix_dir.glob("before-after.*"), *fix_dir.glob("test_trueup_*.py")]:
        stale.unlink(missing_ok=True)  # a run that does not fix must not leave an earlier patch behind
    client = client or ModelClient()
    record_spend(run_dir, "before", client)
    result: dict[str, Any] = {"finding": finding_id, "title": finding["title"], "library": target.library,
                              "found_in": found_in.name, "run_id": run_id, "session_id": tracing.session_id(),
                              "model": PLAN_MODEL, "started": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
                              "tries": [], "fixed": False, "error": None}
    clone = None
    try:
        with tracing.worker("trueup-fixer", step="locate") as span:
            located = loc.locate(root, target, run_dir, finding=finding)
            clone = Path(located["clone"])
            loc.reset_clone(clone)
            loc.save((fix_dir / "locate.json"), (run_dir / "locate.json").read_text())
            result["commit"], result["locate_method"] = located["commit"], located["method"]
            out(f"located with {located['method']}: {len(located['definitions'])} definitions, "
                f"{len(located['callers'])} callers ({located['graph'].get('reason', '')[:160]})")
            tracing.set_verdict(span, located["method"])
        with tracing.worker("trueup-verifier", step="baseline") as span:
            base = baseline(root, clone, located["commit"], target, fix_dir, out)
            tracing.set_verdict(span, f"baseline: {vf.totals(base['sweep'])['leads']} leads")
        result["suites_before"] = {k: {x: v.get(x) for x in ("total", "passed", "failed", "errors", "skipped",
                                                              "failing", "exit")} for k, v in base["suites"].items()}
        messages = pt.first_prompt(finding, target, located, loc.source_excerpts(clone, located),
                                   pt.test_style(clone, target), pt.span_summary(
            sorted({found_in.parent / n for n in finding["details"]["runs"].values()}), finding))
        for n in range(1, max_tries + 1):
            out(f"try {n}/{max_tries}: asking {PLAN_MODEL} for a patch")
            rec: dict[str, Any] = {"try": n}
            with tracing.worker("trueup-fixer", step=f"draft {n}") as span:
                draft = client.chat_json(PLAN_MODEL, messages, max_tokens=12000)
                rec["explanation"] = draft.get("explanation") if isinstance(draft, dict) else None
                rec["draft"] = draft
                try:
                    loc.reset_clone(clone)  # edits are against the original files, not the last try's
                    writes = pt.check_draft(draft, clone, target)
                    tracing.set_verdict(span, "applies")
                except pt.PatchError as e:
                    rec.update(ok=False, stage="apply", reason=f"patch does not apply: {e}")
                    tracing.set_verdict(span, "does not apply")
            if "stage" not in rec:
                with tracing.worker("trueup-verifier", step=f"try {n}") as span:
                    rec.update(verify_try(root, clone, target, finding, draft, writes, base, out))
                    rec["stage"] = "verified" if rec["ok"] else "verify"
                    rec["diff"] = pt.diff(clone)
                    tracing.set_verdict(span, "pass" if rec["ok"] else "fail")
            out(f"try {n}: {'PASS' if rec['ok'] else 'FAIL'}: {_short(rec['reason'], 400)}")
            result["tries"].append(rec)
            if rec["ok"]:
                result["fixed"] = True
                write_fix(fix_dir, finding, target, base, rec)
                break
            messages = pt.revision_prompt(messages, draft, rec["reason"])
    except (ModelError, vf.VerifyError, RuntimeError) as e:
        result["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        out(f"fixer stopped: {result['error']}")
    finally:
        if clone is not None:
            loc.reset_clone(clone)
        record_spend(run_dir, "after", client)
        spend = json.loads((run_dir / "spend.json").read_text())
        result["usage"], result["cost_usd"] = spend.get("usage"), spend.get("run_cost_usd")
        result["spend_after_usd"] = spend.get("after", {}).get("spend_usd")
        write_log(fix_dir, run_dir, result)
    out(f"{finding_id}: {'fixed, verified' if result['fixed'] else 'NOT fixed'} after {len(result['tries'])} "
        f"tr{'y' if len(result['tries']) == 1 else 'ies'}; model cost ${result['cost_usd']}; wrote {fix_dir}")
    return result


def locate_only(root: Path, finding_id: str, out: Callable[[str], None] = print) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Re-run only the locate step (no model call, no patch). Writes fixes/<id>/locate.json and
    graph-compare.json/.md: where the functions the verified patch.diff changed rank among what the
    graph found, next to the ripgrep + ast fallback."""
    finding, _ = find_finding(root, finding_id)
    target = tg.get(finding["library"], finding["details"]["code_path"])
    fix_dir = root / "fixes" / finding_id
    fix_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    old = fix_dir / "locate.json"
    if old.exists() and not (fix_dir / "locate-fix-run.json").exists():
        # The locate output the fix runs used (ripgrep + ast); this re-run replaces locate.json.
        loc.save(fix_dir / "locate-fix-run.json", old.read_text())
    with tracing.worker("trueup-fixer", step="locate only") as span:
        located = loc.locate(root, target, fix_dir, finding=finding)
        clone = Path(located["clone"])
        loc.reset_clone(clone)
        fallback = loc.locate_symbols(clone, target)
        tracing.set_verdict(span, located["method"])
    diff = fix_dir / "patch.diff"
    patched = loc.patched_functions(clone, diff.read_text()) if diff.exists() else []
    res = {"finding": finding_id, "commit": located["commit"], "method": located["method"],
           "graph_reason": located["graph"].get("reason"), "query": located["graph"].get("query"),
           "patched_functions": patched,
           "graph": loc.compare_with_patch(located, patched) if located["graph"]["used"] else None,
           "fallback": loc.compare_with_patch({**fallback, "definitions": [
               {**d, "rank": i} for i, d in enumerate(fallback["definitions"], 1)]}, patched),
           "graph_top": [{"rank": d["rank"], "qualname": d["qualname"], "file": d["file"], "score": d["score"]}
                         for d in located["definitions"][:8]] if located["graph"]["used"] else []}
    loc.save(fix_dir / "graph-compare.json", json.dumps(res, indent=1))
    loc.save(fix_dir / "graph-compare.md", compare_md(res))
    out(compare_md(res))
    return res


def compare_md(res: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    lines = [f"# Locate re-run: {res['finding']}", "",
             f"Method: {res['method']} ({res['graph_reason']}). Clone commit {res['commit'][:10]}.",
             f"Query: {res['query']}" if res["query"] else "", "",
             "| patched function | file | graph rank | ripgrep + ast rank | among graph callers |", "|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    fb = {(r["file"], r["qualname"]): r for r in res["fallback"]["patched"]}

    def rank(r: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
        if r["rank"] is not None:
            return str(r["rank"])
        return f"only its class, at {r['class_rank']}" if r.get("class_rank") else "not found"

    for r in (res["graph"] or res["fallback"])["patched"]:
        lines.append(f"| {r['qualname']} | {r['file']} | {rank(r) if res['graph'] else '-'} | "
                     f"{rank(fb[(r['file'], r['qualname'])])} | "
                     f"{'yes' if res['graph'] and r['among_callers'] else 'no'} |")
    if res["graph"]:
        g = res["graph"]
        lines += ["", f"Graph found {g['found']} of {len(g['patched'])} patched functions, {g['in_top']} in its top "
                      f"{g['top']} (the ones followed up with neighbors and impact). Ranked first: "
                      f"{'yes' if g['same_function_first'] else 'no'}.", "", "Graph top hits:", ""]
        lines += [f"{d['rank']}. {d['qualname']} ({d['file']}, score {d['score']})" for d in res["graph_top"]]
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def write_fix(fix_dir: Path, finding: dict[str, Any], target: tg.Target, base: dict[str, Any],
              rec: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    loc.save((fix_dir / "patch.diff"), rec["diff"])
    test = rec["draft"]["test"]
    loc.save((fix_dir / Path(test["file"]).name), test["content"])
    rows = vf.before_after(finding, base["sweep"], rec["sweep_after"])
    tb, ta = vf.totals(base["sweep"]), vf.totals(rec["sweep_after"])
    loc.save((fix_dir / "before-after.json"), json.dumps({"rows": rows, "before": tb, "after": ta}, indent=1,
                                                          default=str))
    loc.save((fix_dir / "before-after.md"), vf.table_md(rows, tb, ta))


def write_log(fix_dir: Path, run_dir: Path, result: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    tries = []
    for t in result["tries"]:
        t = {k: v for k, v in t.items() if k != "sweep_after"}
        tries.append(t)
    log = {**result, "tries": tries}
    loc.save((fix_dir / "tries.json"), json.dumps(log, indent=1, default=str))
    loc.save((run_dir / "fix.json"), json.dumps(log, indent=1, default=str))
    # Every run's tries are kept, also the runs that did not fix it.
    (fix_dir / "runs").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    loc.save((fix_dir / "runs" / f"{result['run_id']}.json"), json.dumps(log, indent=1, default=str))
    suites = {"before": result.get("suites_before", {}),
              "after": {n: {p: {x: s["after"].get(x) for x in ("total", "passed", "failed", "errors", "skipped",
                                                                  "failing", "exit")} | {"verdict": s["reason"]}
                            for p, s in t.get("suites", {}).items()} for n, t in
                        ((t["try"], t) for t in result["tries"])}}
    loc.save((fix_dir / "suites.json"), json.dumps(suites, indent=1, default=str))
    lines = [f"# {result['finding']}", "", result["title"], "",
             f"Library commit: {result.get('commit', '?')}. Located with {result.get('locate_method', '?')}.",
             f"Model: {result['model']}; cost ${result['cost_usd']} (key spend delta); run {result['run_id']}.", "",
             "Result: " + ("fixed: the new test fails before and passes after, the suites show no new failure, the "
                           "finding's scenarios match truth and the full scenario library has no new mismatch."
                           if result["fixed"] else "NOT fixed. No patch is offered."
                           + (f" Stopped: {result['error']}" if result["error"] else "")), "", "## Tries", ""]
    for t in result["tries"]:
        lines.append(f"{t['try']}. {'PASS' if t['ok'] else 'FAIL'} at {t.get('stage')}: {_short(t['reason'], 700)}")
        if t.get("explanation"):
            lines.append(f"   Model's explanation: {_short(t['explanation'], 500)}")
    if (fix_dir / "before-after.md").exists() and result["fixed"]:
        lines += ["", "## Before and after", "", (fix_dir / "before-after.md").read_text()]
    loc.save((fix_dir / "summary.md"), "\n".join(lines) + "\n")
"""The model drafts the smallest change plus a unit test; code checks and applies it to the clone.

The draft is JSON: exact search/replace edits on files of the target's packages,
and one new test file in the package's tests directory. Code refuses edits outside
those packages, an `old` text that is not found exactly once, and a test file
outside the tests directory. Whether the patch is kept is decided by verify.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from trueup.fixer.targets import Target

SYSTEM = """You fix bugs in AI tracing libraries (OpenTelemetry instrumentations). Trueup ran a real agent \
against a fake provider, so it knows what really happened, and found that the library's spans disagree with it. \
You get the finding, the located wrapper code and its callers, and how the right behaviour looks.

Draft the SMALLEST change that makes the spans match what happened, in the library's own style, plus ONE new \
unit test written like the package's existing tests (same fixtures, same imports, no network, no API keys, no \
cassettes) that fails on the current code and passes with your change. The test must check the outcome a user \
sees (the spans exported, their count, status or attributes), driving the real code path as far as the \
package's tests do (for example a real SDK client with an httpx.MockTransport), not only that some internal \
flag is set. Do not change existing tests. Do not \
reformat code you do not change.

Reply with JSON only:
{"explanation": "cause and fix in 2-4 plain sentences",
 "edits": [{"file": "<path from the repo root>", "old": "<exact text in the file, unique, with enough context>", \
"new": "<replacement>"}],
 "test": {"file": "<path from the repo root, in the package's tests dir, new file named test_trueup_*.py>", \
"content": "<the whole test file>"}}"""


class PatchError(ValueError):
    """The draft cannot be applied. The reason goes back to the model."""


def test_style(clone: Path, target: Target, limit: int = 14_000) -> str:
    """conftest.py and the shortest test files of the first package, to show its test style."""
    tests = clone / target.packages[0].path / target.packages[0].tests
    parts, total = [], 0
    files = [tests / "conftest.py"] + sorted((f for f in tests.glob("test_*.py")), key=lambda f: f.stat().st_size)
    for f in files:
        if not f.exists():
            continue
        text = f.read_text(errors="replace")[:8000]
        if total + len(text) > limit:
            break
        total += len(text)
        parts.append(f"### {f.relative_to(clone)}\n{text}")
    return "\n\n".join(parts)


def code_path_prefix(scenario_id: str) -> str:
    """Scenarios on one code path share an id prefix: "ag-" for ag-run, "p-an-" for planner proposals."""
    parts = scenario_id.split("-")
    return "-".join(parts[:2 if parts[0] == "p" else 1]) + "-"


def span_summary(run_dirs: list[Path], finding: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """What the library exported before the patch, for every scenario on the finding's code path
    (same id prefix), with what really happened: span name, status, description, parent name."""
    prefixes = {code_path_prefix(sid) for sid in finding["details"]["scenarios"]}
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for f in sorted(f for d in run_dirs for f in d.glob("*.json")):
        if not f.stem.startswith(tuple(prefixes)):
            continue
        r = json.loads(f.read_text())
        if not isinstance(r, dict) or not r.get("observation"):
            continue
        t, spans = r["observation"]["truth"], r["observation"]["trace"]["spans"]
        names = {s.get("span_id"): s["name"] for s in spans}
        out[f.stem] = {
            "app": t["app"]["outcome"] if t["outcome"] == "ok" else f"raised {t.get('exception')}",
            "in_finding": f.stem in finding["details"]["scenarios"],
            "spans": [[s["name"], s["status"]["code"], (s["status"].get("description") or "")[:80],
                       names.get(s.get("parent_id"))] for s in spans]}
    return out


def first_prompt(finding: dict[str, Any], target: Target, located: dict[str, Any], source: str,
                 style: str, spans: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    d = finding["details"]
    leads = [{k: x.get(k) for k in ("scenario", "field", "truth", "trace")} for x in d.get("leads", [])]
    user = (f"Library: {target.library} (repo commit {located['commit'][:10]}).\n"

def check_draft(draft: Any, clone: Path, target: Target) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    """The edits plus the test as file writes. Raises PatchError with the reason."""
    if not isinstance(draft, dict) or not isinstance(draft.get("edits"), list) or not draft["edits"]:
        raise PatchError('the reply needs a non-empty "edits" list')
    test = draft.get("test")
    if not isinstance(test, dict) or not test.get("file") or not test.get("content"):
        raise PatchError('the reply needs "test": {"file", "content"}')
    allowed = [p.path.strip("./") for p in target.packages]
    allowed = [a + "/" if a else "" for a in allowed]

    from trueup.fixer.locate import BUILD_DIRS

    def inside(path: str) -> bool:
        parts = Path(path).parts
        return not Path(path).is_absolute() and ".." not in parts and not set(BUILD_DIRS) & set(parts) and any(
            path.startswith(a) for a in allowed)

    files: dict[str, str] = {}
    for e in draft["edits"]:
        if not isinstance(e, dict) or not all(isinstance(e.get(k), str) for k in ("file", "old", "new")):
            raise PatchError('each edit needs string "file", "old" and "new"')
        f = e["file"]
        if not inside(f) or "/tests/" in f"/{f}":
            raise PatchError(f"edit to {f} is outside the library code you may change ({', '.join(allowed)})")
        path = clone / f
        if not path.exists():
            raise PatchError(f"{f} does not exist")
        text = files.get(f, path.read_text())
        n = text.count(e["old"])
        if n != 1:
            raise PatchError(f"the old text of an edit to {f} is found {n} times, not once: "
                             f"{e['old'][:120]!r}" + (nearest(text, e["old"]) if n == 0 else ""))
        files[f] = text.replace(e["old"], e["new"], 1)
    tf = test["file"]
    pkg = next((p for p in target.packages if tf.startswith((p.path.strip("./") + "/" if p.path.strip("./") else "")
                                                              + p.tests + "/")), None)
    if pkg is None or not inside(tf) or not Path(tf).name.startswith("test_trueup_") or not tf.endswith(".py"):
        raise PatchError(f"the test file {tf} must be a new test_trueup_*.py in a package's tests dir")
    if (clone / tf).exists():
        raise PatchError(f"the test file {tf} already exists")
    for f, text in files.items():
        try:
            compile(text, f, "exec")
        except SyntaxError as e:
            raise PatchError(f"{f} does not compile after the edits: {e.msg} at line {e.lineno}") from None
    try:
        compile(test["content"], tf, "exec")
    except SyntaxError as e:
        raise PatchError(f"the test file does not compile: {e.msg} at line {e.lineno}") from None
    return [{"file": f, "content": t} for f, t in files.items()]


def nearest(text: str, old: str) -> str:
    """The lines of the file most like the first line of `old`, to show what is really there."""
    import difflib

    first = next((ln for ln in old.splitlines() if ln.strip()), "")
    lines = text.splitlines()
    best = difflib.get_close_matches(first, lines, n=1, cutoff=0.5)
    if not best:
        return ". No similar line in the file."
    i = lines.index(best[0])
    return ". The file really has, from line " + str(i + 1) + ":\n" + "\n".join(lines[i: i + 8])


def write_files(clone: Path, writes: list[dict[str, str]]) -> None:
    for w in writes:
        p = clone / w["file"]
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(w["content"])


def diff(clone: Path) -> str:

    p = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(clone), "diff"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)

362	def _plan(root: Path, library: str, max_n: int, client: ModelClient, result: dict[str, Any],
363	          out: Callable[[str], None], untraced: Callable[..., Any], save: bool) -> None:
364	    source = wrapper_source(root, library)
365	    findings = latest_findings(root, library)
366	    out(f"planning for {library}: {len(source)} chars of wrapper source, {len(findings)} findings")
367	    reply = client.chat_json(PLAN_MODEL, first_prompt(library, source, findings, max_n))
368	    props = reply.get("proposals") if isinstance(reply, dict) else None
369	    if not isinstance(props, list):
370	        raise ModelError('model reply has no "proposals" list; stopping the planner')
371	    existing = prop.load()
372	    taken = {(s.app, s.model) for s in existing}
373	    ids = {s.id for s in existing}
374	    for p in props[:max_n]:
375	        result["proposals"].append(p)
376	        pid = p.get("id", "?") if isinstance(p, dict) else "?"
377	        history = []
378	        for attempt in range(REVISIONS + 1):
379	            reasons = check(p, taken, ids, untraced)
380	            if not reasons:
381	                break
382	            history.append({"proposal": p, "reasons": reasons})
383	            out(f"  {pid}: rejected ({'; '.join(reasons)[:200]})")
384	            if attempt == REVISIONS:
385	                break
386	            rev = client.chat_json(PLAN_MODEL, revision_prompt(p, reasons))
387	            revised = rev.get("proposals") if isinstance(rev, dict) else None
388	            if not revised:
389	                history.append({"proposal": None, "reasons": ["withdrawn by the model"]})
390	                reasons = ["withdrawn by the model after: " + "; ".join(reasons)]
391	                break
392	            p = revised[0]
393	        if reasons:
394	            result["rejected"].append({"id": pid, "reasons": reasons, "tries": len(history), "history": history})
395	            continue
396	        taken.add((p["app"], p["model"]))
397	        ids.add(p["id"])
398	        path = prop.save(p, library) if save else None
399	        result["accepted"].append({"id": p["id"], "revisions": len(history), "proposal": p,
400	                                   "path": str(path) if path else None})
401	        out(f"  {p['id']}: accepted{f' after {len(history)} revision(s)' if history else ''}")
402	"""The one model client: the openai SDK against an OpenAI-compatible LiteLLM proxy.
403	
404	Every call first asks the proxy what the key has spent (GET <base>/key/info) and
405	refuses to call at or above SPEND_LIMIT. The key and base URL come from
406	TRUEUP_MODEL_KEY and TRUEUP_MODEL_BASE_URL and are never printed or written.
407	"""
408	
409	from __future__ import annotations
410	
411	import json
412	import os
413	import re
414	import time
415	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
416	from pathlib import Path
417	from typing import Any, Callable
418	
419	import httpx
420	
421	PLAN_MODEL = "claude-sonnet-4.6"  # planning and fixing
422	CHEAP_MODEL = "claude-haiku"  # cheap jobs
423	SPEND_LIMIT = 15.0  # USD, from the key's spend on the proxy
424	KEY_VAR, BASE_VAR = "TRUEUP_MODEL_KEY", "TRUEUP_MODEL_BASE_URL"
425	
426	
427	class ModelError(RuntimeError):
428	    """The model could not give a usable answer. Stops the worker that asked."""
429	
430	
431	class SpendLimitReached(ModelError):
432	    """The key has spent SPEND_LIMIT or more. No call is made."""
433	
434	
435	def check_model(name: str) -> str:
436	    if "opus" in name.lower():
437	        raise ModelError(f"model {name!r} is not allowed (no opus models)")
438	    return name
439	
440	
441	def proxy_root(base_url: str) -> str:
442	    """The proxy's root: the base URL without a trailing /v1."""
443	    b = base_url.rstrip("/")
444	    return b[: -len("/v1")] if b.endswith("/v1") else b
445	
446	
447	def get_spend(base_url: str, key: str, http_get: Callable[..., Any] = httpx.get) -> float:
448	    """The key's spend in USD, read from info.spend of GET <root>/key/info."""
449	    r = http_get(proxy_root(base_url) + "/key/info", headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"}, timeout=20)
450	    if r.status_code != 200:
451	        raise ModelError(f"could not read the key's spend: HTTP {r.status_code}")
452	    try:
453	        return float(r.json()["info"]["spend"] or 0.0)
454	    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as e:
455	        raise ModelError(f"could not read the key's spend: no info.spend in the reply ({type(e).__name__})") from None
456	
457	
458	def guard(spend: float, limit: float = SPEND_LIMIT) -> None:
459	    if spend >= limit:
460	        raise SpendLimitReached(f"spend limit reached: the key has spent ${spend:.4f}, limit ${limit:.2f}. "
461	                                "No model call made.")
462	
463	
464	def parse_json(text: str) -> Any:
465	    """JSON from a model reply; a ```json fence around it is allowed."""
466	    t = text.strip()
467	    m = re.fullmatch(r"```(?:json)?\s*(.*?)\s*```", t, re.S)
468	    return json.loads(m.group(1) if m else t)
469	
470	
471	@dataclass
472	class Usage:
473	    calls: int = 0
474	    input_tokens: int = 0
475	    output_tokens: int = 0
476	    by_model: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = field(default_factory=dict)
477	
478	    def add(self, model: str, inp: int, out: int) -> None:
479	        self.calls += 1
480	        self.input_tokens += inp
481	        self.output_tokens += out
482	        m = self.by_model.setdefault(model, {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0, "output_tokens": 0})
483	        m["calls"] += 1
484	        m["input_tokens"] += inp
485	        m["output_tokens"] += out
486	
487	    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
488	        return {"calls": self.calls, "input_tokens": self.input_tokens, "output_tokens": self.output_tokens,
489	                "by_model": self.by_model}
490	
491	
492	class ModelClient:
493	    def __init__(self, key: str | None = None, base_url: str | None = None, *, limit: float = SPEND_LIMIT,
494	                 retries: int = 3, json_retries: int = 2, backoff: float = 2.0,
495	                 http_get: Callable[..., Any] = httpx.get, openai_client: Any = None,
496	                 sleep: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep) -> None:
497	        self.key = key or os.environ.get(KEY_VAR) or ""
498	        self.base_url = base_url or os.environ.get(BASE_VAR) or ""
499	        if not self.key or not self.base_url:
500	            raise ModelError(f"{KEY_VAR} and {BASE_VAR} must be set")
501	        self.limit, self.retries, self.json_retries, self.backoff = limit, retries, json_retries, backoff
502	        self.http_get, self.sleep = http_get, sleep
503	        self.usage = Usage()
504	        if openai_client is None:
505	            import openai
506	
507	            openai_client = openai.OpenAI(api_key=self.key, base_url=self.base_url, max_retries=0, timeout=180)
508	        self.client = openai_client
509	
510	    def spend(self) -> float:
511	        return get_spend(self.base_url, self.key, self.http_get)
512	
513	    def chat(self, model: str, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], max_tokens: int = 4000) -> str:
514	        """One completion, after the spend guard, with retries and backoff on API errors."""
515	        import openai
516	
517	        check_model(model)
518	        last: Exception | None = None
519	        for attempt in range(self.retries + 1):
520	            guard(self.spend(), self.limit)
521	            try:
522	                r = self.client.chat.completions.create(model=model, messages=messages, max_tokens=max_tokens,
523	                                                        temperature=0.2)
524	            except (openai.APIConnectionError, openai.APITimeoutError, openai.RateLimitError,
525	                    openai.InternalServerError) as e:
526	                last = e
527	                if attempt < self.retries:
528	                    self.sleep(self.backoff * 2 ** attempt)
529	                continue
530	            except openai.APIStatusError as e:  # 4xx other than 429: retrying will not help
531	                raise ModelError(f"model call failed: HTTP {e.status_code}") from None
532	            u = r.usage
533	            self.usage.add(model, getattr(u, "prompt_tokens", 0) or 0, getattr(u, "completion_tokens", 0) or 0)
534	            return r.choices[0].message.content or ""
535	        raise ModelError(f"model call failed after {self.retries + 1} tries: {type(last).__name__}")
536	
537	    def chat_json(self, model: str, messages: list[dict[str, Any]], max_tokens: int = 4000) -> Any:
538	        """Like chat, but the reply must be JSON. Invalid JSON is retried, then raises ModelError."""
539	        msgs = list(messages)
540	        for attempt in range(self.json_retries + 1):
541	            text = self.chat(model, msgs, max_tokens)
542	            try:
543	                return parse_json(text)
544	            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
545	                msgs = [*messages, {"role": "assistant", "content": text},
546	                        {"role": "user", "content": f"That was not valid JSON ({e.msg}). Reply with JSON only."}]
547	        raise ModelError(f"model {model} gave invalid JSON {self.json_retries + 1} times; stopping this worker")
548	
549	
550	def record_spend(run_dir: Path, name: str, client: ModelClient) -> float | None:
551	    """Write the key's spend to <run_dir>/spend.json under `name` (before/after). None if unreadable."""
552	    path = run_dir / "spend.json"
553	    data = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {}
554	    try:
555	        spend: float | None = client.spend()
556	        data[name] = {"spend_usd": spend, "at": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())}
557	    except ModelError as e:
558	        spend = None
559	        data[name] = {"error": str(e)}
560	    if name == "after":
561	        data["usage"] = client.usage.to_dict()
562	        if data.get("before", {}).get("spend_usd") is not None and spend is not None:
563	            data["run_cost_usd"] = round(spend - data["before"]["spend_usd"], 6)
564	    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=1))
565	    return spend
566	"""Trueup traces itself with neatlogs.
567	
568	One trueup run = one neatlogs session (session id = run id). Each worker runs as
569	its own root trace named after it (trueup-planner, trueup-runner, ...), with
570	trueup.run_id, trueup.library and, where it applies, trueup.verdict.
571	
572	This is the outer trace only. Scenario runs happen in subprocesses whose env
573	drops NEATLOGS_API_KEY and sets NEATLOGS_DISABLE_EXPORT / OTEL_*_EXPORTER=none
574	(trueup.runner.setups), so their spans never leave the machine.
575	"""
576	
577	from __future__ import annotations
578	
579	import atexit
580	import contextlib
581	import os
582	import sys
583	from typing import Any, Callable, Iterator
584	
585	from trueup import __version__
586	
587	KEY_VAR = "NEATLOGS_API_KEY"
588	WORKERS = ("trueup-planner", "trueup-runner", "trueup-comparer", "trueup-checker", "trueup-deduper",
589	           "trueup-fixer", "trueup-verifier")
590	
591	_state: dict[str, Any] = {"active": False, "run_id": None, "library": None, "flushed": False}
592	
593	
594	def active() -> bool:
595	    return bool(_state["active"])
596	
597	
598	def session_id() -> str | None:
599	    return _state["run_id"] if active() else None
600	
601	
602	def start(run_id: str, library: str, command: str, out: Callable[[str], None] = print,
603	          init: Callable[..., Any] | None = None) -> bool:
604	    """neatlogs.init for a command that calls the model. Returns whether tracing is on."""
605	    _state.update(active=False, run_id=run_id, library=library, flushed=False)
606	    if not os.environ.get(KEY_VAR):
607	        out(f"{KEY_VAR} is not set: running without neatlogs tracing")
608	        return False
609	    if init is None:
610	        import neatlogs
611	
612	        init = neatlogs.init
613	    try:
614	        init(api_key=os.environ[KEY_VAR], workflow_name="trueup", instrumentations=["openai"],
615	             tags=[f"run_id:{run_id}", f"library:{library}", f"trueup:{__version__}", f"command:{command}"])
616	    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - tracing must not stop the run
617	        out(f"neatlogs init failed ({type(e).__name__}): running without neatlogs tracing")
618	        return False
619	    _state["active"] = True
620	    atexit.register(flush)
621	    out(f"neatlogs tracing on, session {run_id}")
622	    return True
623	
624	
625	def flush() -> None:
626	    """Flush neatlogs once. Safe to call more than once and when tracing is off."""
627	    if not active() or _state["flushed"]:
628	        return
629	    _state["flushed"] = True
630	    try:
631	        import neatlogs
632	
633	        neatlogs.flush()
634	    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
635	        print(f"neatlogs flush failed ({type(e).__name__})", file=sys.stderr)
636	
637	
638	@contextlib.contextmanager
639	def worker(name: str, **attrs: Any) -> Iterator[Any]:
640	    """A root trace for one worker in the run's session. Yields a span (or None when off)."""
641	    if name not in WORKERS:
642	        raise ValueError(f"unknown worker {name!r}")
643	    if not active():
644	        yield None
645	        return
646	    import neatlogs
647	
648	    a = {"trueup.run_id": _state["run_id"], "trueup.library": _state["library"], "neatlogs.workflow.name": name,
649	         **{f"trueup.{k}": v for k, v in attrs.items()}}
650	    with neatlogs.trace(name=name, kind="AGENT", session_id=_state["run_id"], **a):
651	        from opentelemetry import trace as otel
652	
653	        yield otel.get_current_span()
654	
655	
656	def set_verdict(span: Any, verdict: str) -> None:
657	    if span is not None:
658	        span.set_attribute("trueup.verdict", verdict)
659	
660	
661	def run_traced(run_id: str, library: str, command: str, body: Callable[[], int],
662	               out: Callable[[str], None] = print) -> int:
663	    """Start tracing, run the command, and flush on the way out, also when it raises."""
664	    start(run_id, library, command, out)
665	    try:
666	        return body()
667	    finally:
668	        flush()

**Base URL:**
```
https://app.neatlogs.com/api/v1/public
```
(EU: `https://eu.app.neatlogs.com/api/v1/public`)

**Authentication:**
- Header: `Authorization: Bearer <service-account-token>`
- Also required: `x-project-id: <project-uuid>` header for project-scoped requests

The API includes "285 operations in the deployed Public API contract." Key resource categories relevant to your query:

- **Traces** - query and inspect trace data
- **Sessions** - manage session records
- **Spans** - access span-level information
- **Detections** - work with detection results
- **Evaluations** - manage evaluation workflows
- **MCP** - dedicated endpoint category for MCP server operations

- **Authentication details:** https://neatlogs.com/api-reference/authentication
- **Operation availability:** https://neatlogs.com/api-reference/availability (review for plan restrictions)

# Neatlogs MCP Server Overview

This is a **Neatlogs MCP server** that enables agents to read observability data (traces, detections, and fix suggestions).

**URL & Authentication:**

The server is hosted at `https://ingest.neatlogs.com/mcp` and uses **API key authentication**. According to the documentation:

> "The server speaks Streamable HTTP and authenticates with your project API key as a bearer token"

The connection requires adding an authorization header with your project key:
```json
"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_PROJECT_KEY"
```

**Purpose:**

Rather than tracing MCP clients, this server allows your coding agent to "query Neatlogs traces, detections, and fix suggestions" directly within tools like Claude Code or Cursor, enabling agents to search production issues and act on recommended fixes without leaving the editor.

"""Group checked leads that share a cause: same library, same check, same code path. Pure.

The code path is the framework for framework scenarios, else the provider API and
whether the app streamed. The trace's shape is part of the key, so "span is OK"
and "span is ERROR without an exception event" stay apart.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Any

from trueup.core.model import Finding, Severity

_INDEX = re.compile(r"^(call \d+ |tool run \d+ \([^)]*\) )")


def field_kind(field: str) -> str:
    return _INDEX.sub("", field)


def code_path(scenario: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    if scenario.get("framework", "none") != "none":
        return scenario["framework"]
    mode = "stream" if "stream" in scenario.get("app", "") else "create"
    return f"{scenario.get('provider')} {scenario.get('api')} {mode}"


def trace_shape(lead: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    trace = lead["trace"]
    if lead["check"] in ("run_status", "call_status") and isinstance(trace, str):
        return trace
    return "missing" if trace in (None, "no span", "no span records an error") else "wrong"


def key(item: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    lead = item["lead"]
    return (lead["library"], lead["check"], field_kind(lead["field"]), code_path(item["scenario"]), trace_shape(lead))


def group(items: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[Finding]:
    """items: {lead, scenario, rules, decided_by}. One Finding per key, in first-seen order."""
    groups: dict[tuple[str, ...], list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for it in items:
        groups.setdefault(key(it), []).append(it)
    out = []
    for (library, check, kind, path, shape), its in groups.items():
        scenarios = sorted({it["lead"]["scenario"] for it in its})
        severity = max(Severity(it["lead"]["severity"]) for it in its)
        sample = its[0]["lead"]
        if shape == "missing":
            says = "not recorded"
        elif check.endswith("status"):
            says = f"is {shape}"
        else:
            says = "recorded wrong"
        caveats = sorted({it["decided_by"]["reason"] for it in its if it.get("decided_by")})
        out.append(Finding(
            id=f"{library}-{check}-{_slug(path)}-{_slug(kind)}-{_slug(shape)}",
            title=f"{library}, {path}: {kind} {says}",
            library=library,
            severity=severity,
            run_ids=tuple(scenarios),
            cause=None,
            details={
                "check": check,
                "field": kind,
                "code_path": path,
                "trace": shape,
                "scenarios": scenarios,
                "example": {"scenario": sample["scenario"], "field": sample["field"], "truth": sample["truth"],
                            "trace": sample["trace"]},
                "rules": {r["rule"]: r["reason"] for r in its[0]["rules"]},
                "caveats": caveats,
                "leads": [it["lead"] for it in its],
            },
        ))
    return sorted(out, key=lambda f: (-f.severity.rank, f.id))


def _slug(s: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s.lower()).strip("-")

def reprove(root: Path, finding_id: str, out: Callable[[str], None] = print) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Apply the committed fixes/<id>/patch.diff to the clean clone and sweep the full scenario library
    again (no model call). Writes fixes/<id>/proof.json: every lead before (the fix's baseline) and after,
    and the finding's scenarios' observations after the patch, so the counts can be recomputed."""
    import subprocess

    from trueup.runner import run_scenario

    finding, _ = find_finding(root, finding_id)
    target = tg.get(finding["library"], finding["details"]["code_path"])
    fix_dir = root / "fixes" / finding_id
    base = json.loads((fix_dir / "baseline.json").read_text())
    clone, commit = loc.ensure_clone(root, target.library)
    if commit != base["commit"]:
        raise RuntimeError(f"clone is at {commit[:10]}, the fix was verified at {base['commit'][:10]}")
    loc.reset_clone(clone)
    p = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(clone), "apply", str((fix_dir / "patch.diff").resolve())],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"patch.diff does not apply: {p.stderr.strip()[-300:]}")
    observations: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def run(py: Path, library: str, sid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        r = run_scenario(py, library, sid)
        if sid in finding["details"]["scenarios"] and r.get("observation"):
            observations[sid] = r["observation"]
        return r

    try:
        fpy = vf.venvs.venv_dir(root, f"{target.library}-fix") / "bin" / "python"
        vf.reinstall(fpy, clone, target)
        out("patched: full scenario library")
        after = vf.sweep_scenarios(fpy, target.library, all_scenarios(), run=run, out=out)
    finally:
        loc.reset_clone(clone)
        vf.reinstall(vf.venvs.venv_dir(root, f"{target.library}-fix") / "bin" / "python", clone, target)
    keep = ("check", "field", "severity", "truth", "trace")
    proof = {"finding": finding_id, "commit": commit,
             "before": {"leads": {s: [{k: m.get(k) for k in keep} for m in ls] for s, ls in base["sweep"]["leads"].items()},
                        "not_run": base["sweep"]["not_run"]},
             "after": {"leads": {s: [{k: m.get(k) for k in keep} for m in ls] for s, ls in after["leads"].items()},
                       "not_run": after["not_run"]},
             "rows": vf.before_after(finding, base["sweep"], after),
             "new_mismatches": vf.new_mismatches(base["sweep"], after),
             "after_observations": observations}
    loc.save(fix_dir / "proof.json", json.dumps(proof, indent=1, default=str))
    tb, ta = vf.totals(base["sweep"]), vf.totals(after)
    out(f"before {tb}; after {ta}; new mismatches {len(proof['new_mismatches'])}")
    return proof
